newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DHL Singapore 1996 shipments top five million.
newsitem.headline: DHL Singapore 1996 shipments top five million.

text.p: Freight company DHL Worldwide Express said on Monday its Singapore operation recorded more than five million shipments for the first time in 1996, with electronics the main growth generator.

DHL Singapore said in a statement its growth was driven by packages and air freight, which rose by 40 percent on an annual basis. The electronics sector remained DHL's main growth generator despite the recent slowdown in the industry, it said.
"DHL's export growth during the year was especially strong for Asia Pacific destinations, with many recording more than 50 percent growth rates," said general manager Charles Chia.
DHL said its Jumbo Box was a significant contributor to the year's overall increase. Since its launch in March 1995, DHL Singapore had shipped over 1.5 million kg of Jumbo products.
